endorsements.name: Wai-leng Lee
endorsements.label: Kill 'em All — DDoS Protection Total Annihilation!
endorsements.description: With the advent of paid DDoS protection in the forms of CleanPipe, CDN / Cloud or whatnot, the sitting ducks have stood up and donned armors... or so they think! We're here to rip apart this false sense of security by dissecting each and every mitigation techniques you can buy today, showing you in clinical details how exactly they work and how they can be defeated. Essentially we developed a 3-fold attack methodology:
